name: Ollama LLM Provider
description: Adds Ollama as an installable local LLM provider through its OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

llmProviders.label: Ollama
llmProviders.description: Run local Ollama models from the target machine.

credentialFields.label: Base URL
credentialFields.helpText: Ollama exposes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint on loopback.

credentialFields.label: Context size (num_ctx)
credentialFields.helpText: Optional. Sent per request as options.num_ctx (e.g. 32768). Leave blank to use the model default.

credentialFields.label: Max tokens (num_predict)
credentialFields.helpText: Optional. Sent per request as options.num_predict. Leave blank for model default.

credentialFields.label: Keep alive
credentialFields.helpText: Optional. Ollama keep_alive (e.g. 5m, -1 to keep loaded). Leave blank for server default.
